<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

class G {
public:
    void run() {
        try {
            string line;
            getline(cin, line);
            istringstream iss(line);
            vector<string> tokens;
            string token;
            while (iss >> token) {
                tokens.push_back(token);
            }
            
            int n = stoi(tokens[0]);
            int m = stoi(tokens[1]);
            int k = stoi(tokens[2]);
            int c = stoi(tokens[3]);
            int d = stoi(tokens[4]);
            
            vector<int> a(k + 1);
            vector<int> f(n + 1, 0);
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                getline(cin, line);
                iss.clear();
                iss.str(line);
                iss >> a[i];
                f[a[i]]++;
            }
            
            int maxl = n + k;
            int T = n * maxl + 1;
            MinCostMaxFlow ans(n * maxl + 2, 0, T);
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (f[i] == 0) continue;
                ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
            }
            
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                    ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                getline(cin, line);
                iss.clear();
                iss.str(line);
                int u, v;
                iss >> u >> v;
                for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                    for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                        if (u != 1)
                            ans.addEdge(n * l + u, n * (l + 1) + v, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                        if (v != 1)
                            ans.addEdge(n * l + v, n * (l + 1) + u, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
                ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
            }
            
            ans.convertToArray();
            ans.calWithPotential();
            
            if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
                cout << "BUG" << endl;
            } else {
                cout << ans.minCost << endl;
            }
        } catch (exception& e) {
            cerr << e.what() << endl;
        }
    }

    class TaskE {
    public:
        class MinCostMaxFlow {
        public:
            struct Edge {
                int u, flow, rid, cost;
                Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
            };

            vector<vector<Edge>> al;
            vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
            vector<int> d;
            int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
            const int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;
            int edges = 0;

            void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
                int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
                al[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
                al[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
            }

            void convertToArray() {
                ja.resize(N);
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    int sz = al[i].size();
                    ja[i].resize(sz);
                    for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                        ja[i][j] = al[i][j];
                    }
                    al[i].clear();
                }
            }

            MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) {
                N = n;
                S = source;
                T = sink;
                maxFlow = 0;
                minCost = 0;
                al.resize(N);
                d.resize(N);
            }

            bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
                fill(d.begin(), d.end(), gmax);
                d[S] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        for (Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                            if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                            if (d[j] != gmax && d[e.u] > d[j] + e.cost) {
                                d[e.u] = d[j] + e.cost;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (check) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        for (Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                            if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                            if (d[j] != gmax && d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }

            vector<int> node, visit, prv, prve, dist;

            bool simple() {
                node.resize(N);
                visit.resize(N, 0);
                prv.resize(N);
                prve.resize(N);
                dist.resize(N);
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), gmax);

                node[0] = S;
                dist[S] = 0;
                int front = 1, back = 0;
                while (front != back) {
                    int u = node[back++];
                    if (back == N) back = 0;
                    visit[u] = 2;
                    for (int i = 0; i < ja[u].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = ja[u][i];
                        if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                        int cdist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                            if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                                node[front] = e.u;
                                if (++front == N) front = 0;
                            } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                                if (--back == -1) back += N;
                                node[back] = e.u;
                            }
                            visit[e.u] = 1;
                            prve[e.u] = i;
                            prv[e.u] = u;
                            dist[e.u] = cdist;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return visit[T] != 0;
            }

            struct pair {
                int F, S;
                pair(int a, int b) : F(a), S(b) {}
            };

            struct pairCompare {
                bool operator()(const pair& A, const pair& B) const {
                    return A.S > B.S;
                }
            };

            bool dijkstra() {
                visit.resize(N, 0);
                prv.resize(N);
                prve.resize(N);
                dist.resize(N);
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), gmax);
                priority_queue<pair, vector<pair>, pairCompare> pq;

                pq.push(pair(S, 0));
                dist[S] = 0;
                while (!pq.empty()) {
                    pair p = pq.top();
                    pq.pop();
                    while (dist[p.F] < p.S) {
                        if (pq.empty()) return false;
                        p = pq.top();
                        pq.pop();
                    }
                    visit[p.F] = 2;
                    for (int i = 0; i < ja[p.F].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = ja[p.F][i];
                        if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                        int cdist = p.S + (e.cost + d[p.F] - d[e.u]);
                        if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                            if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                            pq.push(pair(e.u, cdist));
                            dist[e.u] = cdist;
                            prv[e.u] = p.F;
                            prve[e.u] = i;
                            visit[e.u] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return visit[T] != 0;
            }

            int augment() {
                int p = T;
                int min = gmax;
                while (p != S) {
                    int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                    int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
                    min = min < val ? min : val;
                    p = pp;
                }
                p = T;
                while (p != S) {
                    int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                    ja[pp][pe].flow -= min;
                    ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += min;
                    p = pp;
                }
                maxFlow += min;
                return min;
            }

            bool calSimple() {
                while (simple()) {
                    minCost += dist[T] * augment();
                }
                return true;
            }

            void updPotential() {
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    if (visit[i] != 0) {
                        d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
                    }
                }
            }

            bool calWithPotential() {
                while (dijkstra()) {
                    int min = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
                    minCost += min * augment();
                    updPotential();
                }
                return true;
            }
        };

        int n, m, k, c, d;
        vector<int> a, f;

        void solve(int testNumber, int& n_in, int& m_in, int& k_in, int& c_in, int& d_in, vector<int>& a_in) {
            n = n_in;
            m = m_in;
            k = k_in;
            c = c_in;
            d = d_in;

            int maxl = n + k;
            int T = n * maxl + 1;
            MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);
            a.resize(k + 1);
            f.resize(n + 1, 0);
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                a[i] = a_in[i-1];
                f[a[i]]++;
            }
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (f[i] == 0) continue;
                ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
            }
            
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                    ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                int u, v;
                cin >> u >> v;
                for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                    for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                        if (u != 1)
                            ans.addEdge(n * l + u, n * (l + 1) + v, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                        if (v != 1)
                            ans.addEdge(n * l + v, n * (l + 1) + u, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
                ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
            }
            
            ans.convertToArray();
            ans.calWithPotential();

            if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
                cout << "BUG" << endl;
            } else {
                cout << ans.minCost << endl;
            }
        }
    };

    void solveProblem() {
        int n, m, k, c, d;
        cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        
        vector<int> a(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            cin >> a[i];
        }
        
        TaskE solver;
        solver.solve(1, n, m, k, c, d, a);
    }
};

int main() {
    G g;
    g.solveProblem();
    return 0;
}
